title: Employ staff under the Professional Employees Award 2020
what: Pay and employ staff at no less than the terms of the Professional Employees Award 2020.

sources.title: Professional Employees Award 2020
sources.quote: 4.1 This industry and occupational award covers employers throughout Australia as follows: (a) Employers throughout Australia with respect to their employees performing professional engineering and professional scientific duties who are covered by the classifications in Schedule A —Classification Structure and Definitions of the award and those employees. (b) Employers throughout Australia principally engaged in the information technology industry, the quality auditing industry or the telecommunications services industry and their employees who are covered by the classifications in Schedule A —Classification Structure and Definitions .

reach.condition: if it employs professional engineers or scientists (cl 4.1(a))
reach.note: National system employers that are companies, in every state.

confidence_note: Professional engineers and scientists in any industry (cl 4.1(a)); and employers principally in information technology, quality auditing or telecommunications services (cl 4.1(b)).

assessment.summary: The Professional Employees Award sets classifications, minimum pay and allowances for professional engineers and scientists in any industry, and for staff in information technology and telecommunications.

marks.reason: Classifications, allowances, penalty rates and their record-keeping add to the cost and complexity of employing in the industry.
